findings.subject: entity-mn-nell1
findings.text: In a 70-person NELL1-associated MN series, only 11% had no known secondary association; lipoic acid, NSAID use, autoimmune disease and malignancy were frequent associations. NELL1 antigen identity alone does not establish primary disease, qualifying generalization of NELL1 findings to this primary-only map.
findings.studySystem: Human retrospective three-institution NELL1-associated MN series of 70 patients; mixed secondary associations used solely to qualify primary-scope applicability.
limitations: Mixed secondary-associated cohort is outside the core primary-only population; retained as an applicability qualification, not a causal primary-disease route.
Exposures may overlap; associations do not prove causation.
No treatment recommendation or benefit claim imported.
findings.distinctFindingRationale: Separate cohort added following actual external summary feedback; not independent replication of multiple readouts from the same paper.
